<!--
  Content safety check — ENABLED variant.

  Deployed as the APIM policy fragment "content-safety-check" and included by
  both the Claude and OpenAI operation policies, so prompt moderation can be
  toggled in one place without editing either operation policy.

  Developer-coding thresholds: Violence/SelfHarm are relaxed because stack
  traces, security tooling, and crash discussion trigger false positives for an
  authenticated staff audience. Hate/Sexual stay at the stricter default.
-->
<fragment>
  <llm-content-safety backend-id="content-safety-backend" shield-prompt="true">
    <categories output-type="EightSeverityLevels">
      <category name="Hate" threshold="4" />
      <category name="SelfHarm" threshold="6" />
      <category name="Sexual" threshold="4" />
      <category name="Violence" threshold="6" />
    </categories>
  </llm-content-safety>
</fragment>
variables.$fxv#1:
<!--
  Content safety check — DISABLED variant (no-op).

  Deployed as the APIM policy fragment "content-safety-check" when
  enableContentSafety is false. The Content Safety resource, its RBAC grant, and
  the APIM backend all still exist, so enabling moderation is a parameter flip
  plus redeploy, not a rebuild.

  Why this is currently the default: APIM's llm-content-safety policy
  authenticates to Content Safety through the backend's credentials, and
  backend-level managed identity did not yield a valid token in this
  environment (Content Safety returned 401 "invalid subscription key or wrong
  API endpoint"). The only configurations known to work use a Content Safety
  API key, which this deployment deliberately refuses. Enabling the fragment
  before that is resolved fails closed and blocks every prompt.
-->
<fragment>
  <set-variable name="contentSafetyEnabled" value="false" />
</fragment>
variables.$fxv#2:
<!--
  AI Gateway — POST /v1/messages operation policy

  Order matters. Do not remove or reorder steps without updating the guide.
  {{entra-tenant-id}}, {{gateway-api-client-id}}, {{cowork-client-id}},
  {{approved-claude-models}}, {{backend-forward-timeout}} are APIM named
  values resolved at request time — do not replace with literals.

  BACKEND AUTH: APIM's system-assigned managed identity holds Cognitive
  Services User on the same-tenant Foundry account. No API key exists in this
  stack, in Key Vault, or on any client.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />

    <!-- 1. Entra access-token validation. Both audience forms are accepted:
         v2 tokens carry the bare app-id GUID, v1 tokens the api:// URI. -->
    <validate-azure-ad-token tenant-id="{{entra-tenant-id}}"
        header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401"
        failed-validation-error-message="Missing or invalid access token."
        output-token-variable-name="gatewayJwt">
      <audiences>
        <audience>{{gateway-api-client-id}}</audience>
        <audience>api://{{gateway-api-client-id}}</audience>
      </audiences>
      <client-application-ids>
        <application-id>{{cowork-client-id}}</application-id>
        <application-id>{{additional-client-app-id}}</application-id>
      </client-application-ids>
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="scp" match="any" separator=" ">
          <value>Inference.Invoke</value>
        </claim>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-azure-ad-token>
    <set-variable name="userOid" value="@{
      var jwt = (Jwt)context.Variables["gatewayJwt"];
      return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "");
    }" />

    <!-- 2. Model allowlist ({{approved-claude-models}} is comma-separated, no spaces) -->
    <set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
      var body = context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true);
      return (string)body["model"] ?? "";
    }" />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@{
          var approved = "{{approved-claude-models}}".Split(',');
          var requested = (string)context.Variables["requestedModel"];
          return !approved.Contains(requested);
      }">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="403" reason="Model Not Entitled" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"type":"error","error":{"type":"permission_error","message":"The requested model is not approved for this gateway."}}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>

    <!-- 3. Organization-controlled prompt safety, toggled by the
         content-safety-check policy fragment. -->
    <include-fragment fragment-id="content-safety-check" />

    <!-- 4. Per-user token rate + monthly quota -->
    <llm-token-limit counter-key="@("user:" + (string)context.Variables["userOid"])"
        tokens-per-minute="30000" token-quota="5000000" token-quota-period="Monthly"
        estimate-prompt-tokens="true" retry-after-header-name="Retry-After"
        remaining-tokens-header-name="x-user-tpm-remaining"
        remaining-quota-tokens-header-name="x-user-quota-remaining"
        tokens-consumed-header-name="x-tokens-consumed" />

    <!-- 5. Low-cardinality token metric + metadata-only trace. Never log content. -->
    <llm-emit-token-metric namespace="EnterpriseAI">
      <dimension name="API ID" />
      <dimension name="Backend ID" />
    </llm-emit-token-metric>
    <trace source="ai-gateway" severity="information">
      <message>@("ai_gateway_request")</message>
      <metadata name="correlationId" value="@(context.RequestId.ToString())" />
      <metadata name="userOid" value="@((string)context.Variables["userOid"])" />
      <metadata name="model" value="@((string)context.Variables["requestedModel"])" />
    </trace>

    <!-- 6. Managed-identity backend call. Client-supplied credentials are stripped
         so nothing a caller sends can influence backend authentication. -->
    <set-backend-service backend-id="foundry-claude" />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="x-api-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="api-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" />

    <!-- 7. Streaming: forward Anthropic protocol headers unchanged -->
    <set-header name="anthropic-version" exists-action="skip">
      <value>@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("anthropic-version",""))</value>
    </set-header>
    <set-header name="anthropic-beta" exists-action="skip">
      <value>@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("anthropic-beta",""))</value>
    </set-header>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <!-- Streaming: no SSE buffering, generous forward timeout for long-running calls -->
    <forward-request timeout="{{backend-forward-timeout}}" buffer-response="false" />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>

<!--
  AI Gateway — GET /v1/models operation policy
  Client-discovery endpoint. Does not call a backend — it returns a static JSON
  document describing the models this gateway admits, still gated by the same
  Entra token validation used on /v1/messages so it is not an open probe.

  Claude clients consume this list; the OpenAI models are advertised with their
  own endpoint path so a caller can discover both surfaces from one place.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <validate-azure-ad-token tenant-id="{{entra-tenant-id}}"
        header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401"
        failed-validation-error-message="Missing or invalid access token.">
      <audiences>
        <audience>{{gateway-api-client-id}}</audience>
        <audience>api://{{gateway-api-client-id}}</audience>
      </audiences>
      <client-application-ids>
        <application-id>{{cowork-client-id}}</application-id>
        <application-id>{{additional-client-app-id}}</application-id>
      </client-application-ids>
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="scp" match="any" separator=" ">
          <value>Inference.Invoke</value>
        </claim>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-azure-ad-token>
    <return-response>
      <set-status code="200" reason="OK" />
      <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
        <value>application/json</value>
      </set-header>
      <set-body>@{
        var models = new JArray();
        foreach (var m in "{{approved-claude-models}}".Split(',')) {
          models.Add(new JObject(
            new JProperty("id", m),
            new JProperty("object", "model"),
            new JProperty("endpoint", "/v1/messages")
          ));
        }
        foreach (var m in "{{approved-openai-models}}".Split(',')) {
          models.Add(new JObject(
            new JProperty("id", m),
            new JProperty("object", "model"),
            new JProperty("endpoint", "/openai/v1/chat/completions")
          ));
        }
        return new JObject(
          new JProperty("object", "list"),
          new JProperty("data", models)
        ).ToString();
      }</set-body>
    </return-response>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>

<!--
  AI Gateway — POST /openai/v1/chat/completions operation policy

  Same governance sequence as the Claude surface, applied to the OpenAI wire
  format. Kept as a separate operation because Anthropic Messages and OpenAI
  Chat Completions request/response schemas are not interchangeable.

  {{entra-tenant-id}}, {{gateway-api-client-id}}, {{cowork-client-id}},
  {{approved-openai-models}}, {{backend-forward-timeout}} are APIM named
  values resolved at request time — do not replace with literals.

  BACKEND AUTH: APIM's system-assigned managed identity. No API keys.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />

    <!-- 1. Entra access-token validation. Both audience forms are accepted:
         v2 tokens carry the bare app-id GUID, v1 tokens the api:// URI. -->
    <validate-azure-ad-token tenant-id="{{entra-tenant-id}}"
        header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401"
        failed-validation-error-message="Missing or invalid access token."
        output-token-variable-name="gatewayJwt">
      <audiences>
        <audience>{{gateway-api-client-id}}</audience>
        <audience>api://{{gateway-api-client-id}}</audience>
      </audiences>
      <client-application-ids>
        <application-id>{{cowork-client-id}}</application-id>
        <application-id>{{additional-client-app-id}}</application-id>
      </client-application-ids>
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="scp" match="any" separator=" ">
          <value>Inference.Invoke</value>
        </claim>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-azure-ad-token>
    <set-variable name="userOid" value="@{
      var jwt = (Jwt)context.Variables["gatewayJwt"];
      return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "");
    }" />

    <!-- 2. Model allowlist. Admission decision, kept ahead of every other control. -->
    <set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
      var body = context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true);
      return (string)body["model"] ?? "";
    }" />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@{
          var approved = "{{approved-openai-models}}".Split(',');
          var requested = (string)context.Variables["requestedModel"];
          return !approved.Contains(requested);
      }">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="403" reason="Model Not Entitled" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"error":{"code":"permission_error","message":"The requested model is not approved for this gateway."}}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>

    <!-- 3. Organization-controlled prompt safety, toggled by the
         content-safety-check policy fragment. -->
    <include-fragment fragment-id="content-safety-check" />

    <!-- 4. Per-user token rate + monthly quota, keyed on the validated oid claim. -->
    <llm-token-limit counter-key="@("user:" + (string)context.Variables["userOid"])"
        tokens-per-minute="30000" token-quota="5000000" token-quota-period="Monthly"
        estimate-prompt-tokens="true" retry-after-header-name="Retry-After"
        remaining-tokens-header-name="x-user-tpm-remaining"
        remaining-quota-tokens-header-name="x-user-quota-remaining"
        tokens-consumed-header-name="x-tokens-consumed" />

    <!-- 5. Low-cardinality token metric + metadata-only trace. Never log content. -->
    <llm-emit-token-metric namespace="EnterpriseAI">
      <dimension name="API ID" />
      <dimension name="Backend ID" />
    </llm-emit-token-metric>
    <trace source="ai-gateway" severity="information">
      <message>@("ai_gateway_request")</message>
      <metadata name="correlationId" value="@(context.RequestId.ToString())" />
      <metadata name="userOid" value="@((string)context.Variables["userOid"])" />
      <metadata name="model" value="@((string)context.Variables["requestedModel"])" />
    </trace>

    <!-- 6. Managed-identity backend call. Client-supplied credentials are stripped
         so nothing a caller sends can influence backend authentication. -->
    <set-backend-service backend-id="foundry-openai" />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="api-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="x-api-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <forward-request timeout="{{backend-forward-timeout}}" buffer-response="false" />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>

alertDefinitions.description: Spike in gateway 401s — token audience, consent, or named-value drift.
alertDefinitions.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode == 401 | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ApiId | where Count > 25

alertDefinitions.description: Spike in 403s — content-safety denials or model-allowlist rejections.
alertDefinitions.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode == 403 | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ApiId | where Count > 25

alertDefinitions.description: Sustained 429s — per-user token quota exhausted or runaway automation.
alertDefinitions.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode == 429 | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ApiId | where Count > 50

alertDefinitions.description: Backend 5xx rate — Foundry incident or circuit-breaker activation.
alertDefinitions.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode >= 500 | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), BackendId | where Count > 10

alertDefinitions.description: P95 total gateway latency above the interactive budget.
alertDefinitions.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | summarize P95=percentile(TotalTime, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), ApiId | where P95 > 60000
